questions.question: Evaluate Asvaghosa's philosophy of sunyata in relation to Nagarjuna's / Madhyamika.
questions.solution_html:
• Nagarjuna ‘s concept of shunyata has double aspect- svabhava shunyata
  • appearance are devoid of ultimate reality- everything that that can be
  • grasped by intellect is necessarily relative- shunya from empirical
  • standpoint- neither real nor unreal -not both- it is the rejection of nihilism
  • and eternalism
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Discuss why Carvaka reject inference as a means of knowledge.
questions.solution_html:
• Carvaka accepts pratyksha as pramana- rejects inference – vyapthi -the
  • nerve of syllogism is not perceivable- vicious circle
questions.final_answer: Carvaka accepts pratyksha as pramana- rejects inference – vyapthi -the

questions.question: Discuss the Materialistic foundations of Carvaka Metaphysics.
questions.solution_html:
• Earth , water, fire, air accepted by carvaka- Akasa is not perceivable only
  • inferred – Anumana pramana rejected by carvaka- vyapthi -the nerve of
  • syllogism is not perceivable- vicious circle- matter is the only reality
  • mind as the by product of matter
questions.final_answer: mind as the by product of matter
